semantic.justification: AQF9AG ports consumed UnicodeString owned UTF-16 constructors/copy/bogus/scalar/equality and whole-value append/operator+ projection for timezone rule names. Append preserves a bogus receiver and ignores empty/bogus source text; concat constructs a fresh owner and appends both, so a bogus zero-length prefix does not propagate to the result. IDs, lone surrogate/NUL units and name copies retain exact code units. JS immutable strings/GC project owned value state without native buffers, aliases, capacity, allocation failure, COW/refcounts or ABI guarantees. Native scalar identity and actual transition-name probes plus unit tests cover the stated value slice. Source whole-string compare and const getBuffer now preserve bogus ordering, UTF16 code-unit order and borrowed embedded-NUL spans. Native system-ID lookup and canonical-cache comparisons cover their consumed uses; writable buffer/capacity/native ownership APIs remain unported. Consumed remove clears bogus state, and char32At follows source U16_GET to decode pairs from either lead or trail positions. UTF16 input spans and source integer parsing retain CALC-315 instead of advancing by code point.
